target.label: mid-size TypeScript SaaS web application (payments, background jobs, third-party data acquisition, public scoring surface)

notes: Fifth run against this target class and the first on suite 1.79.0, on the same committed tree and under the identical configuration of the 2026-09-14 row (strong lead over strong operatives, same harness), so the suite version is what moved. Deltas: dispatches 21 to 15, findings 74 to 60, CONFIRMED 28 to 31 (ratio 0.38 to 0.52), nits 17 to 4, highs 4 to 5, operative tokens roughly 2.59M to 3.57M, CONFIRMED per 100k 1.08 to 0.87, covered negatives 164 to 163, paneled 4 of 4 with 25 repro-exempt to 29 of 29 eligible with none exempt, survival 1.00 both runs; atlas falsified 1 to 3 of 11; first conformance snapshot at drift 3 of 5; orchestration discipline 4 of 5 with artifact placement failing. **Orchestration bookkeeping against the version 4 contract was this run’s dominant cost**: the ledger add command mints serial ids instead of contract unit ids, forcing two re-key revisions (L-053); it accepts a missing actor id that strict reconciliation rejects only at finalization, so the contract cannot finalize (L-054); replan and checkpoint demand a fully reported graph, so no mid-run revision bound and the receipt chain can never catch up (L-055). **Panels refined rather than killed (L-034)**: every medium and high was paneled, all 29 survived, eight severities fell and one PROBABLE was promoted on execution; no CONFIRMED label was demoted as static reasoning, so the L-020 fix held. The atlas stamped three sections fresh whose in-scope claims were false when written (L-051, L-052), the auth section still carries its out-of-scope route counts (L-046), and the unmapped count checks only top-level folders (L-056). The anchor revalidator still resolves prose basenames and prose file-and-line mentions (L-027) and reads spaced document names in prose as gone (L-045) while the lead exact check found all 60 fresh. Host capabilities again forced artifacts out of the tracked vault runs folder (L-044). A lead premise carried from a pre-snapshot dirty-tree atlas check was rejected by its operative (L-049). Five prior fixes observed holding and recorded as verified-in edges.
